title.zh: 云产品碳足迹明细数据查询
title.en: Query carbon footprint details of cloud services

descriptions.zh:
碳足迹明细数据的每条数据维度为：uid-月份-云产品-region。

若云账号开通了阿里云资源目录（Resource Directory），且是主管理员或委派管理员角色，则可以查询该资源目录下所有账号的碳足迹明细数据。

否则只能查询本账号的碳足迹明细数据。
descriptions.en:
Each record in the carbon footprint details has the following dimensions: UID, month, cloud service, and region.

If the account has activated Alibaba Cloud Resource Directory and has the role of management account or delegated administrator, you can query the carbon footprint details of all accounts in the resource directory.

Otherwise, you can query only the carbon footprint details of the current account.
